visualCharacteristics: Interior-page title banner: an optional full-width banner photograph stacked directly above a solid brand-blue bar that holds the page H1 in white. No overlaid content card, intro copy, or contact block.
contentPattern: Row 1: banner image (picture, optional). Row 2: page heading (H1). When no image is present, the block is a standalone solid-color title bar with the H1.
usage: Standard page-title header used across interior provider pages.
